AI PARA SA TRAPIKO?

Plano ng Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) na gumamit ng artificial intelligence (AI)-powered traffic signal systems na may video detectors upang pagandahin ang daloy ng trapiko sa Metro Manila.

Maisasaayos daw nito ang daloy ng trapiko sa pamamagitan ng pag-upgrade ng traffic detection mula sa kasalukuyang ground loop detection patungo sa video detection.

Target ng MMDA na gawin ang installation nito sa susunod na taon.

Dee would never again be seen by the people who raised her, but her love would always be there—seen in the colors of her advocacies, felt in the struggle of the masses, and alive in the embers of the revolution.  

Her life was proof that the violence that could come with taking up arms is rooted in an abundance of love, and if love is the universal language, then understanding Dee, at the very least, must be human nature. Her death fuels the fire of the struggle, its afterglow anointing those who will pick up the weapons she dropped and the crown she left—bloodshed to blood pact, ashes to ashes, dust to justice. After all, she was tenderness amidst rot and beauty despite hostility. She was hope in the claws of light.  

As Dee herself said before, “Ang kamatayan ay parte ng giyera. Ngunit, hindi kailanman naging sayang ang buhay na inialay para sa interes ng taumbayan at sa kasarinlan ng ating bansa.”
